# ex: match involving map expression
ex {
	var m map[string]int
	m["key"] -> m["other"]
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() int {
	m := map[string]int{"a": 1}
	return m["key"]
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@

 func F() int {
 	m := map[string]int{"a": 1}
-	return m["key"]
+	return m["other"]
 }
